summary: Sets the global cursor-hidden flag byte_7CE260 to 1, then repeatedly calls the ShowCursor OS API with a zero show-count (ShowCursor(0)) until its return value goes negative, and returns the final ShowCursor result. This is the standard forced-hide idiom that keeps decrementing the OS cursor display counter until it reports a negative count.

local_names.result: last return value of ShowCursor, also the function result

operations.description: Set the global flag byte_7CE260 = 1, marking the cursor as hidden before the OS calls begin.
do-while loop that keeps re-issuing ShowCursor(0) while its return value is still >= 0, forcing the OS cursor display counter down until it reports negative.
Call ShowCursor(0) through the import slot at 0x0059E2C4 to decrement the OS cursor display count; the return value is captured into result and drives the loop condition.
Return the final ShowCursor return value after the loop terminates.
Invoked by ClientGridDisplayTimer (00460380) and WeatherSurfaceUpdate (004628A0) to hide the OS mouse cursor before those paths draw.
